bio: Tirth Dave First-Year Social Committee Oak Yard Hi everyone! My name is Tirth Dave, and I am from Burke, Virginia. I am currently living in Canaday Hall. I decided to join FYSC because I love to meet new people from different backgrounds and make new friends within our class. I am extremely excited to get to know everyone in the Class of 2026 through the events that the FYSC will create! I am here to support the entire Class of 2026 and create lifelong memories and friendships!
